company.name: InfStones
company.shortDescription: InfStones provides decentralized blockchain infrastructure service on one integrated platform.
company.description: Founded in 2018 with offices across three countries and two continents, InfStones is the world's leading blockchain infrastructure provider. Currently, InfStones provides services to large institutional clients around the globe, supporting thousands of nodes on more than 50 public blockchains through its universal platform.

productsAndServices.description: Provides API access to over 80 blockchains with high speed, low latency, and security features for decentralized application development.
productsAndServices.name: Fast API

productsAndServices.description: A node management system that allows users to run dedicated blockchain nodes with automated scaling and maintenance features.
productsAndServices.name: Power Node

productsAndServices.description: A staking service that allows users to safely stake tokens on leading proof-of-stake blockchains through InfStones.
productsAndServices.name: Safe Stake

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring and alert system that provides real-time status and resource utilization tracking for blockchain nodes and APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Block Watch

aiResearchSummary.text: InfStones is researching and developing mechanisms for container scheduling in cloud computing environments, as described in 'Container scheduling for executing dynamic workloads in cloud computing.' The abstract details methods for running multiple container groups on node groups within a computing system, supporting dynamic workloads. This work highlights InfStones' focus on optimizing decentralized blockchain infrastructure through advanced container management.
